title: Nvidia Taps Wall Street for $500 Billion Funding Commitment
description: US investment giants including Apollo Global Management Inc., Blackstone Inc., BlackRock Inc. and Brookfield Asset Management are partnering with Nvidia Corp. to invest $500 billion in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

title: Investor ETF Appeal Of Photonics
description: Mayuranki De, vice president of ETF Trade Strategy at Raymond James, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF (ticker: LYTE), an actively managed ETF that seeks to provide capital appreciation. The Fund invests in the equity securities of companies whose core technology involves generating, manipulating, detecting, or transmitting light for various technologies, such as AI data centers, defense, medical imaging, industrial manufacturing, and quantum computing. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Intel to Sell $15 Billion in Stock After AI Boosts Demand
description: Intel Corp. is offering $15 billion worth of new stock in what represents its first public share sale since the chipmaker listed in 1971, a bid to extend its comeback and capitalize on the AI boom.
